description: Discovery-cycle state record. Phases 1-7 are sourced from the LABORATORY discovery-cycle description (PACK.md build-stage / director-loop text): problem, literature, hypotheses, cheap-computations, critic, verification, sealing. Steps 9-10 (wet-lab validation, publication) are permanently human-gated and never auto-transitioned (PACK.md stages + never-fake rule 8). Source gap: the source text is silent on step 8, so no step-8 behaviour is defined; the enum value 'step-8-unimplemented' is an explicit UNIMPLEMENTED marker that parsers must route around or park on, never invent work under. gate_state: open (auto phases may run), human-gated (parked awaiting a signed human decision record), blocked-on-source (parked on the step-8 source gap or missing required input).

phase.description: Phases 1-7: problem(1), literature(2), hypotheses(3), cheap-computations(4), critic(5), verification(6), sealing(7). step-8-unimplemented: explicit UNIMPLEMENTED marker for the silent step 8, never a working phase. wetlab(9) and publication(10): human-gated terminal phases, entered only via park_for_human_gate and exited only via resume_with_decision.

inputs.description: Inputs available to the current phase (problem_statement, sources, hypotheses, compute_results, critique, verification, sealed_record, wetlab_decision).

outputs.description: Outputs filed by completed phases, keyed by phase name.

gate_state.description: open: transitions may proceed. human-gated: parked at wetlab/publication awaiting an explicit human decision record. blocked-on-source: parked on the step-8 source gap or a missing required input.

parked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the cycle was parked, if parked.

parked_gate.description: Gate name the cycle is parked at (wetlab, publication, or step-8-unimplemented).

history.description: Ordered list of ledger entry_hashes for this cycle's transitions.
